shortDescription: Make worlds and bring them to life, by hand or in your own words.
fullDescription:
Start with an empty world and add to it. Place shapes, move them where they feel right and set them in motion. Every change shows at once.

When words are easier, describe what you want, typed or spoken. An optional helper builds it in your world, and you keep shaping from there. You never need the helper to play.

Each world you make is kept in its own glass sphere on a crystal tree. Turn the tree, look into your worlds and step back into any of them where you left off.

There are no goals, scores or timers. Make something, watch it move, come back later.
